description: A spiritual oracle who walks between worlds. Reads the battlefield, protects allies, debuffs enemies, and deals consistent magic damage. More skills per level to compensate for lower physical defense.

skills.name: Ill Omen
skills.description: Place a spiritual curse on a target, clouding their next action with misfortune.
skills.ai_instruction: Apply Ill Omen status to target. Reduces target's next attack roll by Wisdom modifier. Duration 2 rounds, persists false. Call apply_status with effect='ill_omen', duration=2, persists=false. Narrate as a dark omen hanging over the target.

skills.name: Spirit Bolt
skills.description: Hurl a bolt of pure spiritual energy at a target.
skills.ai_instruction: Make magic attack roll (1d20 + Willpower modifier) vs target magic defense. On hit deal 1d10 + Willpower modifier magic damage. Call apply_damage on hit. On crit: max 1d10 + roll + Willpower modifier.

skills.name: Ward
skills.description: Place a protective ward on yourself or an ally that reduces the next instance of damage taken.
skills.ai_instruction: Apply Ward status to target (self or ally). Reduces next instance of damage taken by Wisdom modifier. Consumed on hit. Call apply_status with effect='ward', duration=3, persists=false. When Ward is active and target takes damage subtract Wisdom modifier from damage before applying, then consume Ward.

skills.name: Sickening Hex
skills.description: Curse a target with a sickening spiritual affliction that deals damage over time.
skills.ai_instruction: Make magic attack roll (1d20 + Willpower modifier) vs target magic defense to land the hex. On hit apply Sickened status — deals 1d4 + Willpower modifier magic damage each round for 5 rounds, persists false. Call apply_status with effect='sickened', duration=5, persists=false. On crit application: immediately deal max 1d4 + Willpower modifier damage on landing, then normal ticks proceed.

skills.name: Dark Insight
skills.description: Read the spiritual aura of a target, revealing their afflictions, weaknesses, and current state.
skills.ai_instruction: No attack roll needed. Read target's current status effects, HP, AP, stats from combat session context. Narrate what the Seer perceives — active afflictions, how wounded they are, any magical auras. This is an information skill. Do not call apply_damage or apply_status. Simply describe what is revealed in rich detail to help the player make strategic decisions.

skills.name: Spirit Shield
skills.description: Summon a spiritual barrier around yourself or an ally that absorbs damage.
skills.ai_instruction: Roll 1d6 + Willpower modifier to determine barrier strength. Apply Spirit Shield status to target (self or ally) with that value as the shield HP. Incoming damage hits the shield first — subtract from shield HP before applying to target HP. When shield HP reaches 0 consume Spirit Shield. Call apply_status with effect='spirit_shield', duration=5, persists=false. Track shield HP value in the status effect.

skills.name: Foresight
skills.description: You have seen this moment before. The next attack against the warded target automatically misses.
skills.ai_instruction: Apply Foresight status to target (self or ally). The next attack targeting them automatically misses regardless of roll. Consumed on trigger. Call apply_status with effect='foresight', duration=3, persists=false. When an attack targets a Foresight-warded entity narrate the Seer having foreseen this exact moment — the attack passes through empty air.

skills.name: Soul Drain
skills.description: Drain the life force from a target, dealing magic damage and healing yourself for half the amount.
skills.ai_instruction: Make magic attack roll (1d20 + Willpower modifier) vs target magic defense. On hit deal 1d10 + Willpower modifier magic damage. Heal actor for half the damage dealt (round down). Call apply_damage on target then restore that HP amount divided by 2 to actor. On crit: max 1d10 + roll + Willpower modifier, heal half of crit total.

skills.name: Omen of Doom
skills.description: You have read the threads of fate and seen this target's doom. The next attack that hits them is guaranteed to critically strike.
skills.ai_instruction: Apply Doomed status to target. The next attack that hits them automatically counts as a critical hit regardless of roll. Apply crit damage rules: max die + roll + modifier. Consumed on trigger. Call apply_status with effect='doomed', duration=3, persists=false. Narrate as the Seer seeing the exact moment of the target's undoing written in the stars.
